vibe_rationale: Closest structural peer to SURPLUS in Japan (retailer-curated sneaker, music and fashion program), but narrower in scene and heavy with big-brand booths.
fit_notes: Retailer-run and multi-format, so a non-competing role such as a workshop, recovery zone or customisation slot could work. Youth-skewed theme with an unknown adult share and little wellness link beyond sport brands. Tokyo-based, so it needs a Japanese partner.
